subject: general
question: Which of the following is an example of using a sample to make inference about a population?

options.text: Statistics of a cricket player in one-day matches

solution:
The correct answer is **"Pre-election poll by media**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In a **census**, the entire population is studied and counted, so there is no need for inference or estimation.
 
• A **pre-election poll by media** is an example of using a sample to make inferences about a population.
